title: Remediation chain verification across later sprint closes
objective: kyro doctor --artifacts and kyro repair integrity accept authorized sprint closes recorded after a remediation chain head, while still detecting real divergence, so PR #154 CI passes and the close validation runs the artifact doctor.

phases.title: Lifecycle-aware remediation verification
phases.objective: Fix the false DIVERGED and unblock chain extension.

tasks.title: Verify remediation chains against their bound checkpoint and accept later authorized closes
tasks.description: doctor --artifacts reports the chain head R-001 of scope sprint-git-traceability as DIVERGED because the remediation lens (src/cli/remediation/plan.ts inspectRemediationTransaction ~421-428) and the verification walk (deriveScopeVerificationState ~943-957) compare the head's result.stateSha256 directly with live state; isSupersededByActiveSprint (~442-451) only excuses an active later sprint, and the digest-directed path resolveScopeEvolution (~659+) is skipped because usesBoundEvolution (~652-656) requires completion data or schemaVersion >= 5. repair integrity prepare is blocked too: resolveRemediationReplayState (~776-831) replays from the newest checkpoint instead of the record's base. Make verification and replay lifecycle-aware: verify each record against the checkpoint image it is bound to (base.checkpoints), then accept later authorized sprint closes whose checkpoints chain from that state; real divergence (any change not explained by the chain plus later authorized closes) must still fail.
tasks.context: Found by a MiniMax diagnostic of PR #154 run 41545795331 (job validate): '[FAIL] sprint-git-traceability/remediation/R-001: DIVERGED: live state digest a6208212... does not match the record result digest 67b904ee...'. R-001 (schemaVersion 4) recorded 3 conventions + ADR-0001 appended after the Sprint 1 close; Sprints 2 and 3 were closed afterwards. Live state equals the Sprint 3 checkpoint after-image. Do not hand-edit .agents/kyro/**. Implementation delegated to Sol 6.1; QA by Astra.
acceptance_criteria: A fixture scope with a post-close remediation record followed by one or more authorized sprint closes passes doctor --artifacts (remediation and verification lenses) — proven by npm run check:scope-remediation and npm run check:verification-states.

In the same fixture, a live change not explained by the chain or a later checkpoint still reports DIVERGED, and repair integrity prepare can extend the chain after later closes — proven by the same checks.

In this repository, node dist/cli.js doctor --artifacts exits 0; npm run build, npm run check:repair-integrity, npm run check:replay-witness, npm run check:lossless-checkpoints, and npm run check:compact-remediation-witness pass.

evidence.summary: Close-validation fix by Sol 6.1: scripts/check-cli-bundle-assets.mjs no longer asserts a hardcoded '315 assertions passed'; it runs the same check-verification-states harness against the source checkout and the projected runtime, requires successful exits and valid summaries, and compares their assertion counts. Remediation logic (checkpoint-bound replay, debt content preservation) unchanged since Astra's approval.
validation: npm run check:cli-bundle-assets: pass, source and projected counts both 523; npm run check:verification-states: 523 assertions passed; npm run check:cli-bundle: pass; npm run build: pass (reported by Sol 6.1)
grep of scripts/ found no other hardcoded counts for check:verification-states or check:scope-remediation (unrelated check:debt-contract count unchanged) (reported by Sol 6.1)
